Definition: of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e. parentless:--comfortless, fatherless.
BiblicalUsage: The fatherless, or comfortless, carry a promise and a command. Jesus said, I will not leave you comfortless, I will come to you, and James says pure religion is to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction.
TheologicalSignificance: What I hold is that the fatherless are the measure of my religion: pure religion is not noise, it is visiting them in their affliction.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
